plain: A breaking of a rule or law, usually a minor one

webster.text: The act of breaking; breach; violation; non-observance; as an infraction of a treaty, compact, agreement or law.

example.quote: To make it void would require an act of election, but to let it go on requires only that we should do nothing, and doing nothing can hardly be an infraction of peace or neutrality.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Opinion on the French Treaties, Apr. 28, 1793
